decisions.reason: A burner component that builds on the core radiant-heater business costs little to sustain and supports the established product range, so there is no reason to withdraw it.
The firm publicly presented this multi-model electric panel line as a flagship of its electrification direction, so its strong commitment and sunk investment make withdrawal very unlikely.
The halogen heater sits on its own page and extends the electric infrared range; it is less central, but any weak results can still be blamed on the early market phase.
This multi-model industrial hall heater line is close to the core business and fits the firm's electrification push, so management stays committed.
The hydrogen-capable series was publicly launched in real operation and is central to the announced low-carbon strategy, so management will persist and treat slow uptake as temporary.
